items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active. Derwin James inactive (hamstring).
items.why: Cleared after foot/ribs issues; Rapoport expected play
items.implication: Start with dock for multi-week injuries; monitor snaps
items.opportunity: primary WR targets if healthy enough

items.text: Mike Evans officially active. Earlier optimistic despite fractured ribs; practiced late week.
items.why: Pushed through ribs; team optimistic, Kittle noted pain but active
items.implication: GTD resolved IN; start but dock for ribs limitation possible

items.text: Lamar Jackson is questionable to return vs. the Titans today due to an ankle injury. Huntley in.
items.implication: Monitor closely; possible limited or out rest of game; Flowers/Henry impact
items.opportunity: if out, Huntley game script change

items.text: WR Ja’Marr Chase is out due to a concussion. Earlier evaluated, return questionable.
items.why: Concussion evaluation during game; ruled out
items.implication: Sit Chase rest of day; Tee Higgins primary beneficiary for targets
items.opportunity: routes/targets/red-zone to Higgins and other CIN WRs; Chase Brown receiving

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) downgraded to doubtful after questionable to return.
items.implication: Likely done; other BUF WRs/TE upside remaining
items.opportunity: targets to remaining Bills pass catchers

items.text: Saquon Barkley has been downgraded to out after hamstring injury early vs Rams. Initially Q to return.
items.why: Hamstring on early carry; limped off, ruled out mid-game
items.implication: Zero remaining production; monitor for Week 5; Eagles backfield opens
items.opportunity: goal-line/carries to backups (Bigsby/Shipley); Hurts rush upside

items.text: Summary weekend reports: EXPECTED TO PLAY Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears. GTD/OPTIMISTIC Mike Evans. NOT EXPECTED Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen. STARTING Tyson Bagent.
items.why: Core ETR Sunday AM dump aligning beat/Schefter/Rap
items.implication: Primary status board for lineup locks; parse per player
items.opportunity: beneficiaries for outs (Addison for JJ already noted)

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin, dealing with a hamstring injury, officially is inactive today in London vs. the Colts.
items.why: Hamstring suffered late week in practice; confirmed inactive
items.implication: Sit McLaurin; look to other WAS pass catchers in London game
items.opportunity: increased targets for remaining WAS WRs/TEs with Daniels also out

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles. Nacua returning from hip/groin, previously speculated for snap count.
items.why: Schefter sources confirm full intended snaps on return
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; upgrade projections, start confidently
items.opportunity: routes/targets/snaps unrestricted vs depleted Eagles secondary

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers has illness on top of knee report; team fully expecting him to play vs Chiefs.
items.why: Illness added but Raiders fully expect play

items.text: QB Marcus Mariota (knee) downgraded to out for Commanders after aggravating MCL; tests upcoming, expect miss time. Hope Jayden Daniels back next week.
items.why: Aggravated MCL; Athan Kaliakmanis in at QB
items.implication: WAS offense further depleted with McLaurin/Daniels out; streamer QB chaos
items.opportunity: Daniels return hope Week 5 elevates WAS weapons ROS

items.text: Eagles OT Lane Johnson inactive today (personal reasons). Rookie Markel Bell starts RT; backup also out. Eagles 18-29 without him.
items.implication: Eagles OL depleted further with Smith/Goedert already out; Hurts protection hit, more pressure
items.opportunity: Rams pass rush upside; possible Hurts scramble/checkdown boost

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin) now; Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Tinier dock Flowers (no hard pitch count). Bigger dock McConkey (foot/ribs) and Evans (ribs). Projecting Sadiq in, Parkinson out.
items.implication: Nacua/Flowers near full; caution McConkey/Evans volume
items.opportunity: Nacua routes full; Flowers targets without pitch count

items.text: Baker Mayfield dislocated thumb expected to sideline 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery.
items.why: Dislocated thumb; grip key to return
items.implication: TB QB change; impacts Evans/Godwin/Irving long-term
items.opportunity: backup QB stream; TB weapons volatility

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring, limited week, Q) is expected to play today.
items.why: Source confirms expected despite Q tag
items.implication: Start Flowers; tiny dock per Levitan

items.text: Excellent spot Nico Collins return: Cowboys DvP inflates opp WR 7.3% most in NFL; Texans high implied points. Eagles without Smith/Goedert/Baun (later +Johnson). Jordan Addison opportunity home vs weak secondary with JJ out.
items.implication: Start Collins smash; Addison smash spot; Eagles pass game depleted favors Rams
items.opportunity: Collins targets/routes high; Addison WR1 volume; Eagles checkdowns/Hurts runs

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (listed in ETR Sunday injuries). Levitan: Addison truthers moment home vs borderline secondary.
items.why: ETR OUT list; confirmed multiple sources
items.implication: Addison clear WR1 opportunity and upgrade

items.text: Awesome to see Austin Ekeler out there again. He looks good! (WAS game chatter amid red zone failures).
items.implication: Positive sign for Ekeler role/usage if volume comes
